lessons.title: 14. Build Chat Messages
lessons.description: Implement `chat_messages(system, user)` returning list of role/content dicts.
lessons.solution_code:
def chat_messages(system, user):
    return [{'role': 'system', 'content': system}, {'role': 'user', 'content': user}]

tests.name: test_chat_messages
tests.unittest_code:
def test_chat_messages(self):
    m = chat_messages('sys', 'hi')
    self.assertEqual(m[0]['role'], 'system')
    self.assertEqual(m[1]['content'], 'hi')

lessons.title: 16. Few-Shot Packing
lessons.description: Implement `few_shot(examples, query)` formatting Input/Output blocks then the query.

tests.name: test_few_shot
tests.unittest_code:
def test_few_shot(self):
    text = few_shot([('2+2', '4')], '3+3')
    self.assertIn('Input: 2+2', text)
    self.assertTrue(text.endswith('Output:'))

lessons.title: 17. Ask for JSON (Practice)
lessons.description: Implement `json_instruction(schema_keys)` telling the model to return JSON with those keys.

tests.name: test_json_instruction
tests.unittest_code:
def test_json_instruction(self):
    s = json_instruction(['name', 'age'])
    self.assertIn('name', s)
    self.assertIn('age', s)
    self.assertIn('JSON', s)
